quotes.author: deon delio
quotes.text: We had an amazing time on the pair of skis we rented with Dalton and Hannah. We were at lake Pleasant and they gave us the rundown in the morning of pickup. And the skis ran exceptionally well, no issues what so ever. They answered all my questions gave a great price last min to get my family on the lake. I would absolutely recommend and I'd definitely rent with them again. Thanks guys 🙏. 👍

quotes.author: Christian Tucker
quotes.text: Dalton and Hannah were very accommodating. I was in town visiting my family and we thought of going jet skiing last minute. Dalton was very quick to return my phone call and within 2 hours I was able to pick up the skis. The ski and equipment was well taken care of and almost new! We had no issues out on the lake and the skis ran great! Lots of fun! Thanks Arizona Jet Ski Rentals!

quotes.author: Nathaniel Zachariah
quotes.text: We rented 2 jet skis for a weekday and even though the weather was cold outside, we enjoyed the experience so much! It’s nice they rent out their jet skis out not just during the summertime because I am not in town often so it was cool to experience Saguaro lake and its beauty at the beginning of the year! Definitely go with Dalton and his team!

quotes.author: tabatha mercado
quotes.text: My daughter and grandson traveled to AZ to visit family. My cousin Gene tented a ATV (RAZR) for us to enjoy and it was amazing. My grandson loved it so much. Gavin was super nice and his family as well greeted us when we came back. If you are looking for a good time to see the nature and mountains he is the guy to see snd have fun. Thank you

quotes.author: Osvaldo Verdugo
quotes.text: Best jet ski rental experience I’ve ever had. Great customer service, super clean and fast jet skis, and the whole process was smooth from start to finish. You can tell they truly care about their customers and take pride in what they do. Easily the best in town and the only company I’d want to rent from again. Highly recommend! 🌊

quotes.author: Autumn Martinez
quotes.text: My family and I had a wonder time at canyon Lake. Rented 2 jetski's. Dalton made the process super easy as he dropped them off to us and picked the up at the end of the day. The skis them self had good power and we had no problems with them at all. One even had a speaker. All and all it was a great deal and was so much fun for the day. I highly recommend renting with these guys. Super professional, on time and went over all instructions and safety. Can’t wait to rent again soon.

quotes.author: Carli Van Valkenberg
quotes.text: I highly recommend going through Dalton when considering renting jet skis! The prices are fair and he is super accommodating and friendly! He can even help deliver the jet skis for a fee! After renting his jet skis, the experience made me want to get my own haha but for now, I will be going through him for rental! He made pickup easy with thorough explanations on the equipment/usage, answered any questions, and just overall made it a seamless experience!

quotes.author: Liza Sanchez
quotes.text: Top Tier customer service! My husband was first drawn to the idea of supporting a fellow veteran's business when looking for a rental, however we were amazed & impressed with the customer service & swift responses we received by Gaven. Not only was he responsive but since we are not too familiar with the area he had great suggestions for making it a memorable day. We will return to rent again and recommend checking out both the jet ski and Razor rentals.
